Built entirely by benchmarks/CMakeLists.txt (cmake --build build --target novasvg_benchmark) from novasvg's own data/ sample corpus. novasvg is driven directly through its C++ API in one process (native/novasvg_native_bench.cpp), same as the other 4 engines through their Python bindings — no CLI, no per-render subprocess. This report is fully self-contained — every image is a base64 data URI, no external files or network access required to view it.
